Fiscal Q4 2026 is the quarter ended May 31, 2026. Neither filing reports it directly, so I derive it as full-year cost of sales minus the nine-month cost of sales.

- Full-year fiscal 2026 cost of sales (10-K): $26,487 million
- Nine months ended February 28, 2026 cost of sales (10-Q): $20,908 million
- Q4 2026 cost of sales = 26,487 − 20,908 = $5,579 million

As a check, Q4 revenue is 46,398 − 35,426 = $10,972 million. That gives Q4 gross profit of 19,911 − 14,518 = $5,393 million, and 10,972 − 5,393 = 5,579, which matches.

**Nike's cost of revenue in fiscal Q4 2026 was about $5,579 million.**
